clips.name: Idle
clips.intent: relaxed ready stance with a slow breath; weapon hand low

clips.name: Run
clips.intent: fast forward-leaning sprint, short quick strides, arms pumping, weapon trailing

clips.name: Jump
clips.intent: knees tucked, arms up, launch pose

clips.name: Fall
clips.intent: legs loose, arms out for balance

clips.name: Slide
clips.intent: low feet-first slide, leaning back, one hand down
clips.reference: video A slope descents, sheets a_04 8:00

clips.name: AttackSwing
clips.intent: upper-body horizontal sword slash, right to left, torso twist

clips.name: AttackCast
clips.intent: upper-body staff thrust forward with the off hand open

clips.name: AttackThrow
clips.reference: video B bone and banana throws

clips.name: Downed
clips.intent: collapsed on one knee, head down, loop

clips.name: Kneel
clips.intent: kneeling on one knee leaning on the weapon, the death-screen pose

clips.name: Cheer
clips.intent: victory: weapon raised overhead, small hop

clips.name: PortalStep
clips.intent: step forward out of the portal and settle into Idle

rules: Locomotion clips play at Core priority so attack overlays (Action, upper body only) never freeze the legs.
Attack overlays pose the torso and arms only; legs are left out of the clip.
Each clip is rendered holding that hero's real weapon and judged against its reference frames.
note: roblox-animation. Match a reference by ANGLE and fraction-of-reach, not distance.
